reported.quote: Coming on to the Q3 results, as you see, we have been able to drive a strong high single -digit volume growth of 7.9% which is strong.

reported.label: Q3 value growth
reported.speaker: Amit Syngle
reported.quote: The value growth was about 2.8%, so you can see the difference between the value and the volume was approximately about 5%

reported.quote: I think a good steady business in terms of what we have done. We see there is a 6.3% value growth, in constant currency terms i t boils down to about 4.2%, given the fact that INR has depreciated.
